label: Hotel Ebbstein, Möwensund
html:
<style>
  @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:ital,opsz,wght@0,9..144,400;0,9..144,600;1,9..144,400&family=Instrument+Sans:wght@400;500;600&display=swap');
  /* Hotel Ebbstein: fourteen rooms in the old net loft on the north quay of a Baltic harbour town. Bands of one 78rem
     grid: the header, the hero standing on the water with the search, the rooms, the restaurant, the packages, the way
     there, the reviews, the questions and the footer. Looks: Harbour (white, harbour blue, a signal red), Linen (sand
     and terracotta, paper tags) and Night (navy and lantern amber). */
  #in-hotel {
    --background: oklch(0.985 0.006 230);
    --foreground: oklch(0.24 0.045 250);
    --card: oklch(1 0 0);
    --card-foreground: var(--foreground);
    --popover: oklch(1 0 0);
    --popover-foreground: var(--foreground);
    --muted: oklch(0.955 0.012 230);
    --muted-foreground: oklch(0.47 0.035 245);
    --border: oklch(0.9 0.015 235);
    --input: oklch(0.85 0.02 235);
    --primary: oklch(0.42 0.1 245);
    --primary-foreground: oklch(0.985 0.006 230);
    --secondary: oklch(0.95 0.015 230);
    --secondary-foreground: var(--foreground);
    --accent: oklch(0.94 0.02 230);
    --accent-foreground: var(--foreground);
    --ring: var(--primary);
    --radius: 0.75rem;
    --radius-sm: max(0px, calc(var(--radius) - 4px));
    --radius-md: max(0px, calc(var(--radius) - 2px));
    --radius-lg: var(--radius);
    --radius-xl: calc(var(--radius) + 4px);
    --ht-band: oklch(0.955 0.014 230);
    --ht-signal: oklch(0.55 0.19 28);
    --ht-tag: oklch(0.99 0.004 230);
    --ht-tag-ink: oklch(0.24 0.045 250);
    --ht-tag-edge: oklch(0.42 0.1 245);
    --ht-ring: oklch(0.78 0.11 85);
    --ht-note: oklch(0.99 0.004 90);
    --ht-note-ink: oklch(0.24 0.045 250);
    --ht-pin: oklch(0.55 0.19 28);
    --ht-deep: oklch(0.4 0.09 240);
    --ht-shallow: oklch(0.6 0.08 220);
    --ht-light: oklch(0.94 0.03 210);
    --ht-display: 'Fraunces', Georgia, serif;
    --ht-gutter: max(clamp(1rem, 4vw, 2.5rem), calc((100% - 78rem) / 2));
    color-scheme: light;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    container: ht / inline-size;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    width: 100%;
    overflow-x: clip;
    background: var(--background);
    color: var(--foreground);
    font-family: 'Instrument Sans', var(--font-sans);
    line-height: 1.55;
  }
  #in-hotel[data-look='linen'] {
    --background: oklch(0.965 0.018 80);
    --foreground: oklch(0.27 0.03 50);
    --card: oklch(0.985 0.01 80);
    --popover: oklch(0.985 0.01 80);
    --muted: oklch(0.93 0.022 78);
    --muted-foreground: oklch(0.47 0.035 55);
    --border: oklch(0.87 0.025 75);
    --input: oklch(0.8 0.03 70);
    --primary: oklch(0.52 0.13 42);
    --primary-foreground: oklch(0.985 0.01 80);
    --secondary: oklch(0.92 0.025 78);
    --accent: oklch(0.92 0.03 70);
    --radius: 0.25rem;
    --ht-band: oklch(0.935 0.026 78);
    --ht-signal: oklch(0.52 0.13 42);
    --ht-tag: oklch(0.8 0.065 72);
    --ht-tag-ink: oklch(0.27 0.03 50);
    --ht-tag-edge: oklch(0.6 0.06 65);
    --ht-ring: oklch(0.55 0.03 60);
    --ht-note: oklch(0.985 0.01 80);
    --ht-note-ink: oklch(0.27 0.03 50);
    --ht-pin: oklch(0.86 0.04 85 / 0.85);
    --ht-deep: oklch(0.45 0.05 200);
    --ht-shallow: oklch(0.68 0.05 180);
    --ht-light: oklch(0.95 0.03 85);
  }
  #in-hotel[data-look='night'] {
    color-scheme: dark;
    --background: oklch(0.16 0.035 265);
    --foreground: oklch(0.93 0.02 85);
    --card: oklch(0.2 0.04 265);
    --popover: oklch(0.2 0.04 265);
    --muted: oklch(0.23 0.04 265);
    --muted-foreground: oklch(0.76 0.03 85);
    --border: oklch(0.31 0.045 265);
    --input: oklch(0.36 0.045 265);
    --primary: oklch(0.82 0.13 78);
    --primary-foreground: oklch(0.16 0.035 265);
    --secondary: oklch(0.25 0.045 265);
    --accent: oklch(0.26 0.045 265);
    --radius: 0.5rem;
    --ht-band: oklch(0.19 0.04 265);
    --ht-signal: oklch(0.82 0.13 78);
    --ht-tag: oklch(0.8 0.12 80);
    --ht-tag-ink: oklch(0.18 0.035 265);
    --ht-tag-edge: oklch(0.62 0.11 70);
    --ht-ring: oklch(0.86 0.1 85);
    --ht-note: oklch(0.24 0.045 265);
    --ht-note-ink: oklch(0.93 0.02 85);
    --ht-pin: oklch(0.82 0.13 78);
    --ht-deep: oklch(0.14 0.04 265);
    --ht-shallow: oklch(0.3 0.07 255);
    --ht-light: oklch(0.85 0.12 80);
  }
  #in-hotel [hidden] {
    display: none !important;
  }
  #in-hotel :is(h1, h2, h3, .dialog-title, .card-title, .mk-section-header-title, .mk-faq-title) {
    font-family: var(--ht-display);
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: -0.01em;
    text-wrap: balance;
  }
  #in-hotel[data-look='linen'] :is(h1, h2, .mk-section-header-title, .mk-faq-title) {
    font-weight: 400;
    font-style: italic;
  }
  /* layers of one look */
  #in-hotel [data-for] {
    display: none;
  }
  #in-hotel[data-look='harbour'] [data-for~='harbour'],
  #in-hotel[data-look='linen'] [data-for~='linen'],
  #in-hotel[data-look='night'] [data-for~='night'] {
    display: block;
  }
  /* the bands: one 78rem grid, alternating grounds */
  #in-hotel > :is(section, footer) {
    box-sizing: border-box;
    width: 100%;
    padding: clamp(3.5rem, 7vw, 6rem) var(--ht-gutter);
    scroll-margin-top: 4.5rem;
  }
  #in-hotel > .ht-alt {
    background: var(--ht-band);
  }
  #in-hotel .mk-section-header {
    max-width: none;
    margin: 0 0 2.5rem;
    padding: 0;
  }
  #in-hotel .mk-section-header-title {
    font-size: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 2.75rem);
    line-height: 1.05;
  }
  #in-hotel .mk-section-header-eyebrow {
    color: var(--primary);
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    font-size: 0.8125rem;
  }
  /* the header bar */
  #in-hotel .mk-header {
    border-block-end: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
  #in-hotel .mk-header-inner {
    max-width: none;
    padding-inline: var(--ht-gutter);
  }
  #in-hotel .mk-header-brand,
  #in-hotel .mk-header-name {
    color: var(--foreground);
  }
  #in-hotel .mk-header-name {
    font:
      600 1.375rem/1 var(--ht-display),
      Georgia,
      serif;
  }
  #in-hotel .mk-header-brand small {
    display: block;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font:
      500 0.6875rem/1.2 'Instrument Sans',
      sans-serif;
    letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  #in-hotel .mk-header-brand svg {
    width: 1.75rem;
    height: 1.75rem;
    color: var(--primary);
  }
  #in-hotel .mk-header-nav .nav-menu-link {
    font-size: 0.9375rem;
  }
  #in-hotel .mk-header-actions .select {
    width: auto;
  }
  #in-hotel .site-mode {
    flex: none;
    border: 1px solid var(--input);
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    background: var(--background);
    color: var(--foreground);
  }
  #in-hotel .site-mode:hover {
    background: var(--accent);
    color: var(--accent-foreground);
  }
  /* the hero: the promise beside the harbour, then the quay edge and the water with the search on it */
  #in-hotel > .ht-hero {
    padding: 0;
  }
  #in-hotel .ht-hero .mk-hero {
    max-width: none;
    margin: 0;
    padding: clamp(3rem, 7vw, 5.5rem) var(--ht-gutter) clamp(3rem, 6vw, 4.5rem);
    align-items: center;
    gap: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 4.5rem);
  }
  #in-hotel .mk-hero-copy {
    max-width: 36rem;
  }
  #in-hotel .mk-hero-badge {
    border-color: var(--border);
    background: var(--card);
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
  }
  #in-hotel .mk-hero-title {
    font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 4.25rem);
    line-height: 1.02;
    font-weight: 600;
  }
  #in-hotel .mk-hero-title em {
    color: var(--primary);
    font-weight: 400;
  }
  #in-hotel .mk-hero-desc {
    font-size: 1.125rem;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
  }
  #in-hotel .ht-photo {
    position: relative;
    margin: 0;
    aspect-ratio: auto;
    overflow: visible;
    border-radius: 0;
    background: none;
  }
  #in-hotel .ht-photo img {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    height: auto;
    aspect-ratio: 5 / 4;
    object-fit: cover;
    border-radius: 12rem 12rem var(--radius-xl) var(--radius-xl);
  }
  #in-hotel[data-look='linen'] .ht-photo img {
    border-radius: var(--radius);
    box-shadow:
      0 0 0 0.6rem var(--card),
      0 0 0 calc(0.6rem + 1px) var(--border);
  }
  #in-hotel .ht-photo figcaption {
    margin-block-start: 0.75rem;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.875rem;
  }
  /* the key tag hung over the photo: the check-in and check-out times */
  #in-hotel .ht-keytag {
    position: absolute;
    top: 8%;
    left: -1.75rem;
    display: grid;
    justify-items: center;
    width: 8.5rem;
    rotate: -9deg;
    transform-origin: 50% 0;
    filter: drop-shadow(0 0.6rem 0.8rem oklch(0.2 0.04 250 / 0.3));
  }
  #in-hotel .ht-keytag-ring {
    width: 2.4rem;
    height: 2.4rem;
    margin-block-end: -0.9rem;
    border: 0.3rem solid var(--ht-ring);
    border-radius: 50%;
  }
  #in-hotel .ht-keytag-body {
    display: grid;
    justify-items: center;
    gap: 0.15rem;
    width: 100%;
    padding: 1.4rem 0.75rem 1rem;
    border: 2px solid var(--ht-tag-edge);
    border-radius: 3.5rem 3.5rem 1.2rem 1.2rem;
    background: var(--ht-tag);
    color: var(--ht-tag-ink);
    text-align: center;
  }
  #in-hotel .ht-keytag-body::before {
    content: '';
    width: 0.8rem;
    height: 0.8rem;
    margin-block-end: 0.35rem;
    border: 2px solid var(--ht-tag-edge);
    border-radius: 50%;
  }
  #in-hotel .ht-keytag b {
    font: 600 2.25rem/1 var(--ht-display);
  }
  #in-hotel .ht-keytag small {
    font-size: 0.6875rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  #in-hotel .ht-keytag span {
    font-size: 0.8125rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 1.3;
  }
  #in-hotel[data-look='linen'] .ht-keytag-body {
    border-style: dashed;
    border-radius: 0.3rem;
    clip-path: polygon(22% 0, 78% 0, 100% 14%, 100% 100%, 0 100%, 0 14%);
  }
  #in-hotel[data-look='linen'] .ht-keytag-ring {
    width: 0.3rem;
    height: 3rem;
    margin-block-end: -1.4rem;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: 0;
    background: var(--ht-ring);
  }
  #in-hotel[data-look='night'] .ht-keytag-body {
    box-shadow: 0 0 2.5rem -0.5rem oklch(0.82 0.13 78 / 0.6);
  }
  /* the quay edge and the water: a Shader, the search on top */
  #in-hotel .ht-water {
    position: relative;
    isolation: isolate;
    padding: clamp(1.75rem, 4vw, 3rem) var(--ht-gutter);
    border-block-start: 0.5rem solid var(--ht-tag-edge);
    background: var(--ht-deep);
  }
  #in-hotel .ht-water .shader {
    opacity: 0.9;
  }
  #in-hotel .ht-search {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)) auto;
    align-items: end;
    gap: 1rem;
    padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
    background: var(--card);
    color: var(--card-foreground);
    box-shadow: 0 1.5rem 3rem -1.5rem oklch(0.15 0.04 250 / 0.55);
  }
  #in-hotel .ht-field {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.4rem;
    min-width: 0;
  }
  #in-hotel .ht-field .label {
    margin: 0;
  }
  #in-hotel .ht-field :is(.input, .select, .date-input) {
    width: 100%;
  }
  #in-hotel .ht-search output {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.25rem 0.75rem;
    padding-block-start: 0.85rem;
    border-block-start: 1px solid var(--border);
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.9375rem;
  }
  #in-hotel .ht-search output b {
    color: var(--foreground);
  }
  /* the rooms */
  #in-hotel .ht-rooms {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(min(100%, 17rem), 1fr));
    gap: 1.25rem;
  }
  #in-hotel .ht-room {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    transition: opacity 0.25s;
  }
  #in-hotel .ht-room .card-body {
    flex: 1;
  }
  #in-hotel button.card-media {
    position: relative;
    aspect-ratio: 4 / 3;
    width: 100%;
    padding: 0;
    border: 0;
    background: var(--muted);
    cursor: zoom-in;
  }
  #in-hotel button.card-media img {
    transition: scale 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1);
  }
  #in-hotel button.card-media:hover img {
    scale: 1.04;
  }
  #in-hotel button.card-media:focus-visible {
    outline: 3px solid var(--ring);
    outline-offset: -3px;
  }
  #in-hotel .ht-room-tag {
    position: absolute;
    inset: auto auto 0.75rem 0.75rem;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.35rem;
    padding: 0.3rem 0.65rem;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: oklch(0.15 0.03 250 / 0.7);
    color: #fff;
    font-size: 0.8125rem;
    font-weight: 500;
  }
  #in-hotel .ht-room-tag svg {
    width: 0.9rem;
    height: 0.9rem;
  }
  #in-hotel .ht-fit {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0.75rem 0.75rem auto auto;
  }
  #in-hotel .ht-facts {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 0.6rem 1rem;
    margin: 0;
  }
  #in-hotel .ht-facts dt {
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  #in-hotel .ht-facts dd {
    margin: 0;
    font-weight: 500;
  }
  #in-hotel .ht-rate {
    margin: 1rem 0 0;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.875rem;
  }
  #in-hotel .ht-rate b {
    color: var(--foreground);
    font: 600 1.5rem/1 var(--ht-display);
  }
  #in-hotel .ht-room .card-content {
    display: flex;
    flex: 1;
    flex-direction: column;
  }
  #in-hotel .ht-room .ht-rate {
    margin-block-start: auto;
    padding-block-start: 1rem;
  }
  #in-hotel .ht-total {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.1rem;
    margin-block-start: 0.6rem;
    padding: 0.6rem 0.75rem;
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    background: var(--muted);
    font-size: 0.8125rem;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  }
  #in-hotel .ht-total b {
    color: var(--foreground);
    font-size: 1rem;
    font-weight: 600;
  }
  #in-hotel .ht-room[data-fit='no'] :is(.card-media img, .card-header, .ht-facts, .ht-rate) {
    opacity: 0.55;
  }
  #in-hotel .ht-room[data-fit='no'] .ht-total {
    background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ht-signal) 12%, var(--card));
  }
  #in-hotel .ht-room .card-footer {
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }
  /* the room dialogs: a photo viewer beside the details */
  #in-hotel dialog.ht-room-dialog {
    max-width: 60rem;
  }
  /* the request is a two-column form: wider than the Dialog's lg */
  #in-hotel dialog.ht-book {
    max-width: 40rem;
  }
  #in-hotel .ht-room-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.25fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
  }
  #in-hotel .ht-viewer {
    display: grid;
    align-content: start;
    gap: 0.75rem;
    padding: 1rem;
    background: var(--muted);
  }
  #in-hotel .ht-viewer .mk-media-gallery-track {
    border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  }
  #in-hotel .ht-viewer .mk-media-gallery-track img {
    aspect-ratio: 4 / 3;
    max-height: none;
    object-fit: cover;
    border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  }
  #in-hotel .ht-viewer .mk-media-gallery-track p {
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    text-align: start;
  }
  #in-hotel .ht-viewer .mk-media-gallery-track:focus-visible {
    outline-color: var(--ring);
  }
  #in-hotel .ht-viewer-steps {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 0.75rem;
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  }
  #in-hotel .ht-viewer-steps div {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0.5rem;
  }
  #in-hotel .ht-amenities {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 0.5rem 1rem;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    list-style: none;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
  }
  #in-hotel .ht-amenities li {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    align-items: flex-start;
  }
  #in-hotel .ht-amenities svg {
    flex: none;
    width: 1.05rem;
    height: 1.05rem;
    margin-block-start: 0.15rem;
    color: var(--primary);
  }
  #in-hotel .ht-sub {
    margin: 1.25rem 0 0.6rem;
    font-family: 'Instrument Sans', var(--font-sans);
    font-size: 0.8125rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
  }
  #in-hotel .ht-x {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0.75rem 0.75rem auto auto;
    z-index: 1;
    background: var(--popover);
  }
  #in-hotel .dialog .dialog-footer {
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }
  #in-hotel .dialog-title {
    font-size: 1.5rem;
  }
  #in-hotel .mk-header-sheet-actions {
    display: grid;
  }
  /* the restaurant and the bar */
  #in-hotel .ht-dining {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1.1fr);
    gap: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 4rem);
    align-items: start;
  }
  #in-hotel .ht-dining .mk-section-header {
    margin-block-end: 1.5rem;
  }
  #in-hotel .ht-hours {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    margin: 0 0 2rem;
  }
  #in-hotel .ht-hours div {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 1rem;
    padding-block-end: 0.5rem;
    border-block-end: 1px dashed var(--border);
  }
  #in-hotel .ht-hours dt {
    font-weight: 600;
  }
  #in-hotel .ht-hours dd {
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    text-align: end;
  }
  #in-hotel .ht-menu {
    display: grid;
    gap: 1rem;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    list-style: none;
  }
  #in-hotel .ht-menu li {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
    gap: 0.15rem 1rem;
  }
  #in-hotel .ht-menu b {
    font: 600 1.125rem/1.3 var(--ht-display);
  }
  #in-hotel .ht-menu span {
    grid-column: 1;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.9rem;
  }
  #in-hotel .ht-menu i {
    grid-row: 1;
    grid-column: 2;
    font-style: normal;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    font-weight: 600;
  }
  #in-hotel .ht-plates {
    position: relative;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1.4fr 1fr;
